entities.name: Abu Ubaid al-Qasim bin Salam
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Ubaid al-Qasim ibn Sallam al-Khurasani al-Harawi was an Arab philologist and the author of many standard books on lexicography, Qur’anic sciences, hadith, and fiqh.
